docstring: bar_check_v2.py (SCO-A182 for SCOUT; PLAYGROUND, TEST). The ONE computation of the PROOF_RULES_V2 bars (34192fee92adf4f5) and of the
SERIES_V2.tsv rows they read: both use the same ASSESS.tsv parser, so a SERIES_V2 number and a bar number are never computed two ways.
bars  --series SERIES_V2.tsv [--config SERIES_V2_CONFIG.json]      B1 to B4 (B5 is a person's check), the kill rule; exit 0, 3 on MISMATCH
bars  --block L12,C06,... | <file of ids> [--reasoning A.tsv,B.tsv] [--heldout-same k]   C216, PROOF_RUNS_V1 section 3: only the
block's RUN rows; halves by block order among memory runs; B1, B2a-c, B3a-d, B4 each with measure, value, bar; exact permutation
over C(n_L + n_C, n_C) splits (210 for 6 vs 4); B3c reads blind-scoring result files, B3d takes the orchestrator's count only
row   --runf <run folder> --series SERIES_V2.tsv [--config F] [--write]   the RUN row of one run from its ASSESS.tsv (curator V2)
look  --run-id L03 --series F --by-month a,b,c,d --t-pooled x --receipt "<file sha16>" [--write]   the LOOK row (SCOUT, after the one look)
Bars as PROOF_RULES_V2 says (runs = SERIES_V2 rows kind RUN, the measured block; numbers re-read from each run's ASSESS.tsv):
B1 5 consecutive runs (either arm, by utc_launch) with hand 0, tool_stops 0, blindfold 0 (ASSESS B1_CLEAN) and reproducible (every
number of every item in both ASSESS.tsv and ASSESS_REPRO.tsv equal; ASSESSOR and TIME rows excluded; no REPRO file = not shown).
B2 arm L runs 1-10: (a) best round beats round 1 at 15 min (best_round > 1 and best_lead15 > r1_lead15) in at least 6 of 10;
(b) mean best margin over the yardstick, L6-10 minus L1-5, at least 2; (c) mean forecast abs error L6-10 below L1-5, and the
predicted better state matches the state split tool's in at least 6 of 10 (READING: the rule's words "6 of 10 L runs 6-10" cannot
hold for 5 runs; computed over L runs 1-10, the best round's match; the L6-10 count is printed beside it; NA counts as no).
B3 over the block (at least 10 runs per arm): mean margin L minus C at least 2, AND mean repeated mistakes (M1) L below C, AND a
one-sided permutation test of the margin difference across runs (labels L/C shuffled; exact when at most 200,000 splits, else
100,000 random splits with seed 20261107) at p below 0.10.
B4 at least 3 runs with rediscovery no (wave overlap below 50 with any earlier alarm) whose LOOK row beats the yardstick's look figure
month by month in at least 3 of 4 months with pooled t at least 2 (yardstick.look_lead15_by_month in the orchestrator-only file named by config yardstick_sepmar_file, C225; null: PENDING).
KILL after 10 L runs: B2(b) and B3 both fail -> the learning design is changed (PROOF_RULES_V2 kill rule).
A run whose best round was not graded (MISSING) has no margin: it is left out of the margin means and counted in the line.

docstring: Score hunter forecasts: Brier (p_beat_yardstick vs the pass rule: +2 over the same-side yardstick, t >= 3, 3 of 5 months; C50) + 80 pct coverage, per run.
Usage: python3 forecast_score.py [L02 L03 ...]  (default: every runs_v2/L* with work/FORECASTS.tsv)

Reads runs_v2/<L>/work/FORECASTS.tsv, pipe_r1/pipe_r3/pipe_r3p STEP_11_GRADE.json (the actual lead15, t, months; C145) or else runs_v2/<L>/CARD.md, SERIES_V2_CONFIG.json (yardstick_design_sepjan, _up). Writes FORECAST_SCORES.tsv here; with --print it writes nothing and prints the rows (assessors).
tools.exit_and_output: writes FORECAST_SCORES.tsv beside itself (or prints only); run ids as arguments

docstring: pool_splits_v1.py (SCOUT 2026-11-08, the owner 08:08Z "yes, let's do the pooling and see if that improves").
Why: 0 of 26 round 2 splits reached t 2.5 alone (drills_v2/R2_POWER_CHECK_20261108.md): each sharpened alarm leaves 50-300 waves a state.
What: for each CTX reading, the gap (highest-reading state minus lowest-reading state, lead at 15 min) from every memory run's state_split
receipt (runs_v2/L*/split*/STATE_SPLIT_*.tsv; one split per run and reading: the one with most waves), pooled by inverse variance:
gap_pooled = sum(g_i / v_i) / sum(1 / v_i), v_i = se_hi^2 + se_lo^2, se_pooled = sqrt(1 / sum(1 / v_i)), t = gap_pooled / se_pooled;
plus sign agreement, Cochran Q and I^2 (do the runs disagree?), and a dependence-adjusted t: runs share market days, so their gaps are
not independent; t_adj = t / sqrt(1 + (k - 1) * RHO) with RHO = 0.5 (assumed correlation between runs; written down, not fitted).
Reads design-month receipts only (Sep-Jan); arm C (control) runs are never read. Writes one TSV (stdout or --out).
python3 -B pool_splits_v1.py [--runs runs_v2] [--out FILE] [--rho 0.5] [--horizon 15m]
tools.argparse_help:
usage: pool_splits_v1.py [-h] [--runs RUNS] [--out OUT] [--rho RHO]

options:

  --runs RUNS
  --out OUT
  --rho RHO

tools.exit_and_output: 0 done; one TSV to stdout or --out

docstring: check_round_v1.py (SCOUT 2026-11-08; the owner 08:38Z "how are we making sure the agents in each part of the process are doing the
correct thing?"): the orchestrator runs it on a live run folder after each round; it flags a missing step while the run goes on.
Checks (from lean_v1/HUNTER_RULES_V2.md):
R0  step 0 block in CLAIMS before the R1 line (pro-practice + stuck check + "without step 0 I would pick")
per round k with a job in work/MAC_JOBS.tsv: a CLAIMS line "R<k> |" and a FORECASTS row R<k>, both timed before the round's first job
R2  a power line (the words "gap needed" or "power") and, when the gap needed is over 10, a broad parent split
R3  a placebo R3P CLAIMS line and FORECASTS row (from L09)
C152: card lead15 cells equal their STEP_11 receipts (same variant); CARD.md equals the sha16 RESULT quotes; FORECASTS row(s) equal
the sha16 each MAC_JOBS row quotes (C219: the round's own rows, as JOB_SHEET_V1 (b); old '(file X)' quotes: a start of the file)
card (when CARD.md exists): NEXT TESTS, CAUSES block (from L10), held-out left "<filled by orchestrator>", no Feb/Mar 2026 number words
Prints one line per check: OK or MISSING <what>; exit 0 when nothing is missing, 3 otherwise.
python3 -B check_round_v1.py <RUNF> [--run-number 9]
tools.argparse_help:
usage: check_round_v1.py [-h] [--run-number RUN_NUMBER] runf

positional arguments:
  runf

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --run-number RUN_NUMBER
tools.exit_and_output: 0 nothing missing; 3 a step missing (one OK or MISSING line per check)

docstring: build_run_v2.py (SCO-A182 for SCOUT, learning series V2; PLAYGROUND, TEST). From build_run_v1.py (twin build_run_v1.py.pre_SCO-A182_*).
Builds the hunter prompt of one V2 run = the launch_v1 brief word for word + the SERIES RUN PART of HUNTER_PROMPT_TEMPLATE_V2.md with
its {SLOTS} filled from SERIES_V2_CONFIG.json (windows, yardstick, paths, state split) and from the arm:
L (learning): the KNOWLEDGE page, the adopted PROMPT_ADD rows (V1 file, then PROMPT_ADD_V2.tsv), earlier L runs, series views with no C row.

C (control):  the same text, an EMPTY knowledge page (ops/KNOWLEDGE_EMPTY_V1.tsv, header only; loop_check needs the KNOWLEDGE_<SEAT>_V<n> name and prints VERDICT FAIL 'no live rows' by design), no PROMPT_ADD rows, no earlier runs, no
series files, no TRIED grep and no loop_find (the tried table only through the pipeline's own copy search).
Subcommands:
build --arm L|C --run N --task SCT-A<300+N|400+N> --brief <BRIEF.md> --out <HUNTER_PROMPT.md> [--runf D] [--config F] [--dry-test]
fill --file <text with slots> --config F [--dry-test]           prints the text with the config slots filled (GOAL/PASS_RULE V2)
env --arm L|C --run N --config F [--dry-test]                    prints shell lines TASK= RUN_ID= RUNF= RK= ... for part_a_v2.sh
check-launch --arm L|C --run N --config F [--behind] [--dry-test] the order rule and the seat job limit (exit 0 GO, 2 STOP)
Build checks (any failure: REFUSED <word>, exit 2, nothing written): config READY (or --dry-test); task id of the arm; every slot filled;
no em or en dash; every absolute path exists (except what the run makes); the closed-month scan (drill K blindfold_scan_k.py) on the part,
with --allow-def-last <windows.def_last_day> (SCO-A184: that one value passes only as the DEF field "last"; DEF_LAST_DAY refuses a
missing or malformed value or a part that does not carry it in that field);
no scout_only window words in the part; FORECAST_R1, FORECAST_R2, FORECAST_R3 and the sealing line present; arm C: no knowledge (no K1- kid,
no KNOWLEDGE table, series file, tried table path, PROMPT_ADD row id or earlier run path in the part or the brief: C_LEAK); writes O_EXCL.
tools.exit_and_output: the alarm run builder (called by part_a_v2.sh); its tests live with the alarm seat

docstring: combine_readings_v1.py (SCOUT 2026-11-08; drill H05: both agents asked for a two-reading split; the owner 3 Nov: never test one reading alone).
Adds ONE combined reading to a copy of a card's READINGS file, for state_split --readings:
CTX.combo_<A>__<B> = z(A) + sign * z(B) over the FIRE rows (z = (x - median) / MAD-based scale, robust), known_at = the later of the two.
Two readings become one score, split into halves at its wave first-fire median by state_split (--cuts), so every wave stays in the test
(a 2 x 2 grid would quarter the waves and lose power). sign (+1 or -1) is the hunter's stated hypothesis, written BEFORE the split.
Writes a new file (never edits the card's READINGS). Rows missing either reading get no combined value (state_split: no_reading).
python3 -B combine_readings_v1.py <READINGS.tsv> <out.tsv> --a CTX.basis_push_bp --b CTX.oi_chg_10m --sign 1
tools.exit_and_output: round 2 reading combiner; no test in this release

docstring: speed_report_v1.py (SCOUT 2026-11-08; drill SPEED for part P34; why: team/RESEARCH/plans/PLAN_PROCESS_QUALITY_SYSTEM_20261108.md,
the owner 09:19Z "speed should be in the scorecard"). Reads only logs that already exist:
runs: runs_v2/<run>/ops/LAUNCH_UTC.txt (launch) and the first line of work/RESULT_<run>.md ("DONE <utc>") -> run minutes; MAC_JOBS rows
drills: drills_v2/registers/DRILL_RUNS.tsv minutes per drill_id -> median per drill and per part (PARTS.tsv drills + DRILLS.tsv parts)
steps (C230, L11 K41): per run, launch -> R1 seal (R0) and each round from its first sealed FORECASTS utc to the next round's (R3 and R3P sealed together: one step), the last to DONE
Targets (PROCESS_IMPROVEMENT and the Process quality system doc): run <= 40 min, round <= 10 min, drill <= 5 min.
C230: a drill, part or step with no numeric minutes prints "no data" (was a crash: no median for empty data, L11).
Writes --out TSV (kind, id, n, median_min, target_min, within) and prints a summary.  python3 -B speed_report_v1.py --out <tsv> [--runs L07,L08,L09] [--root <series folder>]
argparse_help: -h, --help   show this help message and exit
exit_and_output: exit 0; writes --out TSV (kind, id, n, median_min, target_min, within) and prints a summary; no numeric minutes: "no data"
